summary_1line: In the Kuru court, Bhishma supports the Pandavas’ rightful claim and peace, Karna defiantly rejects yielding land, and Dhritarashtra decides to send Sanjaya as envoy.
themes: rival counsel in the Kuru court

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal council hall, the aged Bhishma rises in shining armor while Karna angrily interrupts him before the gathered Kuru nobles.
Blind king Dhritarashtra sits on his throne as courtiers surround him and he orders Sanjaya to go as envoy to the Pandavas.
